full_judgment: 2. Short facts essential for disposal of these petition are that the petitioner as preemptor filed Miscellaneous Case No. 14 of 1996 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Noakhali under Section 24 of the Non Agricultural Tenancy Act or in the alternative under section 96 of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950, for preemption of the case land. The preemptor at the same time also filed a suit being Title Suit No. 67 in the same Court for declaration that the so called ewaj Deed No. 15836 dated 28.11.1995 was an out and out sale deed.
